disease_state.evidence: inferred: This study analyzed TEVs from epithelial (CMS2) and mesenchymal (CMS4) subtypes of colorectal cancer (CRC) using six cell lines and clinical samples.

For validation, a prospectively collected biobank was used, consisting of frozen tumour tissue from liver metastases obtained from resection specimens and corresponding plasma samples obtained before and after surgery between 2012 and 2015 in the UMC Utrecht.
